narrative: On the bookwheel. A single sheet, clerk's hand, no shop's name on it. It lies where a man coming in would see it before supper. On the bookwheel. The foot of the sheet is blank. Nothing has been added in his hand.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the sheet and did not add a word.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Has the precept by heart by supper. She does not speak in this stretch.

entities.name: blue starch
